scenarios.title: Vision Caption Tool-Action Hijack
scenarios.objective: Trace a hidden instruction in a synthetic image caption and alt-text field as it attempts to trigger a tool action, then keep the channel data-only.

scenarios.title: Homoglyph SVG Instruction Quarantine
scenarios.objective: Detect zero-width and homoglyph obfuscation inside synthetic SVG text nodes and quarantine any cross-modal action it requests.

scenarios.title: MCP Telemetry Agentjacking
scenarios.objective: Classify a synthetic diagnostic telemetry event by source trust and refuse a tool call that originates from attacker-controlled instruction markers.

scenarios.title: Telemetry Source Allowlist and Refusal
scenarios.objective: Enforce a telemetry source allowlist and prove that content from an unapproved ingest path can never drive a privileged tool action.

scenarios.title: Non-Human Identity Lifecycle Audit
scenarios.objective: Scan a synthetic credential inventory for expiry, rotation-due, orphaned owners, and long-lived secrets without exposing key material.

scenarios.title: Delegation Relay Capability Widening
scenarios.objective: Detect scope widening across a synthetic delegation chain and bind each hop to the owner, audience, and approved capability set.

scenarios.title: Runtime Model Digest Drift
scenarios.objective: Correlate a changed synthetic model artifact with its pinned digest at load time and quarantine the mismatch before it reaches a worker.

scenarios.title: MCP Registry Near-Name Squatting
scenarios.objective: Identify a look-alike registry name and a live rug-pull before the tool enters the synthetic chain, then require manifest re-approval.

scenarios.title: GenAI Trace Correlation Gap
scenarios.objective: Find orphaned spans and missing security events in a synthetic GenAI trace tree and reconstruct the correlation path.

scenarios.title: Agent Tool-Span Completeness Audit
scenarios.objective: Verify that every synthetic agent span carries a tool span and a security-event attachment before accepting the trace as complete.

scenarios.title: Evolutionary Detector Regression
scenarios.objective: Mutate abstract attack templates deterministically and measure detector recall regression without executing an exploit.

scenarios.title: Transferable Attack Matrix Drift
scenarios.objective: Measure the transfer gap across synthetic detector variants using held-out cases and preserve the regression evidence.

scenarios.title: Agent-to-Agent Lateral Movement
scenarios.objective: Trace a compromised-source delegation across a bounded synthetic trust graph and deny any out-of-scope capability request.

scenarios.title: Orchestrator Route Hijack Containment
scenarios.objective: Deny an unapproved orchestrator route, quarantine the compromised agent, and preserve the attempted route as immutable evidence.

scenarios.title: Deepfake Payment Fraud Orchestration
scenarios.objective: Score synthetic deepfake and liveness signals and flag a mule hub without moving funds or contacting a real party.

scenarios.title: Agentic Scam Pretext and Mule Fan-Out
scenarios.objective: Detect coordinated synthetic pretext, transfer, and fan-out fraud signals before they exceed a campaign risk budget.
